items.name: Revolution Idle
items.sub: Oni Gaming · Casual, Simulation, Free To Play
items.desc: Revolution Idle is a free idle incremental game with offline progress, prestige layers, and endless automation. Start simple, reach infinity and go further.

items.name: DUNGEON SLASHER
items.desc: Navigate maps filled with enemies, destroying all who get in your way! Use a variety of character, artifact, and skill synergies to defeat the dungeon!

items.name: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library!
items.desc: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library! is a single-player simulation. You need return scattered books to proper places in an Arcane Library. As completed rows of bookshelves, you can learn ability to improve your efficiency. Use your skills and strategies to shelve 3,072 books as quick as you can.

items.name: Retro Rewind - Video Store Simulator
items.desc: Manage your very own video store in the early 90s! Rent, sell, decorate and expand your business from the ground up and relive the golden ages of video rentals!

items.name: sobosuba
items.desc: sobosuba is a merge game with ultra-squishy soft-body physics. Satisfying and relaxing -but strategy, tricks, and skill matter for chasing high scores.

items.name: My Card Is Better Than Your Card!
items.sub: Utu Studios · Casual, Strategy, Early Access
items.desc: Become the coolest kid of the playground in this playful roguelike deckbuilder. Craft every card yourself with adorable stickers and wow your rivals in tug-of-war card battles full of wonder!

items.name: Nientum - Op.ZERO
items.desc: A 2D action-adventure where the story unfolds by tuning the stage with music. A play by Aleph and Liora, who have lost their memories. A beautiful yet eerie stage, and the secret of the forgotten theater await. Your choices will determine the play's ending — and their fates.

items.name: shapez 2 - Factory
items.desc: Dive into a factory-building game with the focus on just that – building huge space factories! Design sprawling multi-level factories and satisfying production lines without limits. Tackle progressively challenging automation goals at your own pace, without the threat of enemies.

items.name: GONE Fishing
items.desc: GONE Fishing is a 1-8 player survival horror game where you and your friends must work together to stay alive, by fishing. The only way to survive is to keep feeding the lake’s insatiable hunger before it feeds on you. Can you satisfy the hunger... or will you become the next offering?

items.name: Buckshot Roulette
items.desc: Play Russian roulette with a 12-gauge shotgun. Four enter. One leaves. Roll the dice with your life. Good luck!

items.name: Fire Bug
items.desc: Hold the sun in your hand in this fast-paced arcade game. Play as a magnifying glass and cook swarms of bugs before time runs out. Chain ignitions, defeat tier bosses, and spend your Sparks on upgrades tree to unlock explosive criticals, burn trails, and smoldering spore clouds.

items.name: Outcast Tales
items.desc: A challenging post-apocalyptic roguelite turn-based RPG about the psychological stresses of adventuring with complete idiots. Lead a crew of flawed heroes against the consequences of their own terrible decisions. Can you keep your heroes together when everyone thinks they're in charge?

items.name: Checkmate: The Red General’s Last Move
items.desc: Checkmate is a turn-based Xiangqi roguelite where a lone red general carries a cannon into a 9×10 battlefield. Move to reload, fire risky snap shots, aim for precision, and use enemy pieces as firing screens. Each upgrade also strengthens the opposing army.

items.name: Mahjong Rush
items.desc: A single-player mahjong roguelike with an ink-wash art style. Make runs and sets from your tiles to score points — complete a winning hand and your score multiplies. Buy Flower cards, talismans and treasures to get stronger.. Never played mahjong? A step-by-step tutorial gets you started.

items.name: Operator: Observation
items.desc: Take on the role of Colin Nox, a security operator monitoring surveillance cameras for anomalies. What starts as a routine job quickly turns sinister as the anomalies grow more aggressive, invading the houses you watch, breaking into your home, and crawling into your mind.
